audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart marks every single row 'Skill' while content win[] already correctly has Tristana levels 1-5, Skill at 6, Nilah at first item and late. The two layers directly contradict each other on 5 of 7 rows.
audit.why: Nilah is melee with no ranged poke pre-6, so Tristana's range wins early outright (not a coinflip); her Q lifesteal-sharing and Apotheosis heal/shield flip the late game to her once she has an item — that's a real power shift, not a 50/50.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-3].side to Tristana and phases[5-6].side to Nilah to match the existing, already-correct content win[] rows; rewrote each why to state the actual reason instead of the generic jump-bomb-R template.

audit.why: Content spikes already correctly place the swings at level 3 (range poke), level 6 (Buster Shot vs Apotheosis+Slice and Dice), first item (Nilah's lifesteal-sharing spike), and late (Apotheosis team shield).

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Nilah's sustain (Joy Unending passive, Apotheosis R) needs anti-heal timing called out, and it wasn't named anywhere; breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit.
audit.why: Joy Unending shares healing/shielding and Apotheosis heals on the pull, so Grievous Wounds items matter and weren't named; Jubilant Veil's actual cooldown (26-22s) and Rocket Jump's (22-14s) were missing from the cooldowns field.
audit.corrected: Added Executioner's Calling / anti-heal to itemization and real cooldown numbers to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Contest level 1 autos — your early range is real and the all-in threat starts at 2; set the tone.
edits.after: You win level 1 outright — Nilah is melee and must walk into your auto range to farm, so poke freely and deny her CS.

edits.before: Jump-bomb all-ins open: W in off any support CC and the E detonation math is already rude.
edits.after: Your range keeps denying her CS at level 2 — poke with autos and Explosive Charge while she's stuck last-hitting up close.

edits.before: Full kit: E the target, stack it with autos, and R the finish — the lane's most honest kill threat.
edits.after: Level 3 stays yours: Explosive Charge and auto poke punish her melee last-hitting before her sustain items land.

edits.before: Trade around the bomb: four stacks detonate — back off at three or commit at four; never linger between.
edits.after: Through 4-5 you still hold the range edge — keep poking before her first-item lifesteal spike arrives.

edits.before: First item spike: the jump-bomb-R string deletes squishies and the resets chain through fights.
edits.after: Nilah's first-item spike is brutal — her lifesteal-sharing and Q sustain let her out-duel you in extended fights; disengage instead of trading toe-to-toe.

edits.before: Late Trist jumps the resets: E the carry, R the peel, and jump out — or in — on every takedown.
edits.after: With 2+ items her shielding ult and dashes dominate teamfights — kite her engages and never let her force the extended melee duel.

edits.before: Your all-in is his entire laning nightmare — jump the windows, stack the bomb, and end the lane before his curve enrolls.
edits.after: Your all-in is her entire laning nightmare — jump the windows, stack the bomb, and end the lane before her curve enrolls.

edits.before: E the bomb, stack two autos, and step back at three — the threat does the zoning and the fourth stack stays loaded.
edits.after: Four Explosive Charge stacks detonate — poke to two stacks, then back off at three so the fourth never triggers on you instead of Nilah.

edits.before: Jumping in with the bomb unstacked and R down — Tristana without the string is a yordle tourist at a gunfight.
edits.after: Buster Shot's knockback breaks her Apotheosis pull before it lands — holding it only for a kill confirm wastes its best use as an interrupt.

edits.before: Your all-in is his entire laning nightmare — jump the windows, stack the bomb, and end the lane before his curve enrolls.
edits.after: Your all-in is her entire laning nightmare — jump the windows, stack the bomb, and end the lane before her curve enrolls.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Kraken or Stormrazor first, Berserker's, then IE — attack speed feeds the bomb stacks. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Kraken or Stormrazor first, Berserker's, then IE — attack speed feeds the bomb stacks. Add Executioner's Calling early against her Joy Unending and Apotheosis sustain.

edits.before: - Nilah Jubilant Veil: matchup-defining — Dodges ALL attacks while it shimmers — never auto into the veil; spells still land. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rocket Jump (reset) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Nilah Jubilant Veil (26-22s): matchup-defining — dodges ALL attacks while it shimmers — never auto into the veil; spells still land. Count it out loud. - Your W Rocket Jump (22-14s) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - Your R (100s) has one too: the moment it all goes right.
